Montessori activities simplified: Phonetic reading cards: To prepare for spelling, writing and reading.

How does it work: A child uses the knowledge of phonetics to spell the words and match them against the corresponding picture. Noteworthy here is that there is no rote-method/memorizing of spellings involved. This also prepares the child to read and write more intuitively (and willingly) vs. rote/copying based methods.

Self-Expression: Students enjoyed a delightful storytelling session with professional storyteller – Bethany, who brought the story Monkey Puzzle to life.

Through the engaging tale, students explored themes of friendship, communication, and helping others. Bethany’s expressive storytelling captivated the children and inspired their imagination and creativity.

A big thank you to Bethany for a wonderful storytelling session! 🌟
